title: Well Completion Report
description: Well Completion Report contract normalized from the DocuBricks Energy library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-energy-well-completion-report
  title: Well Completion Report
  description: Well Completion Report contract normalized from the DocuBricks Energy library.
  version: energy_well_completion_report_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: energy/well_completion_report
    sourcePath: Schemas/energy/well_completion_report
    sourceVersion: energy_well_completion_report_v1
    sourceDigest: c5728b8e7fda9bb4e6bb2cd580120b7569df87fe69b323d6fa13dda4f86ecadc
spec:
  documentType: well_completion_report
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - completion-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - choke-size
        - completion-type
        - contractors
        - fluid-volume
        - formation
        - proppant-volume
        - stimulation-summary
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - initial-gas-rate-mcfpd
        - initial-oil-rate-bpd
        - initial-water-rate-bpd
        - perforated-intervals
        - total-depth
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - field-name
        - operator-name
        - well-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - api-well-number
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - regulatory-filing-status
  fields:
    - id: completion-date
      name: completion_date
      label: Completion Date
      description: Date completion operations finished or report was signed.
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/completion_date
    - id: well-name
      name: well_name
      label: Well Name
      description: Well name and number.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/well_name
    - id: api-well-number
      name: api_well_number
      label: Api Well Number
      description: API well number or regulatory well identifier.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/api_well_number
    - id: operator-name
      name: operator_name
      label: Operator Name
      description: Operating company.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/operator_name
    - id: field-name
      name: field_name
      label: Field Name
      description: Field, pool, or reservoir name.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/field_name
    - id: formation
      name: formation
      label: Formation
      description: Producing formation or target zone.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/formation
    - id: completion-type
      name: completion_type
      label: Completion Type
      description: Completion type such as hydraulic fracture, open hole, perforated casing, or recompletion.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/completion_type
    - id: total-depth
      name: total_depth
      label: Total Depth
      description: Total measured depth.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/total_depth
    - id: perforated-intervals
      name: perforated_intervals
      label: Perforated Intervals
      description: Perforation intervals with top, bottom, stage, and date when available.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/perforated_intervals
    - id: stimulation-summary
      name: stimulation_summary
      label: Stimulation Summary
      description: Fracturing, acidizing, stimulation, or treatment summary.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/stimulation_summary
    - id: proppant-volume
      name: proppant_volume
      label: Proppant Volume
      description: Total proppant volume.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/proppant_volume
    - id: fluid-volume
      name: fluid_volume
      label: Fluid Volume
      description: Total stimulation fluid volume.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/fluid_volume
    - id: initial-oil-rate-bpd
      name: initial_oil_rate_bpd
      label: Initial Oil Rate Bpd
      description: Initial oil production rate in barrels per day.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/initial_oil_rate_bpd
    - id: initial-gas-rate-mcfpd
      name: initial_gas_rate_mcfpd
      label: Initial Gas Rate Mcfpd
      description: Initial gas production rate in thousand cubic feet per day.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/initial_gas_rate_mcfpd
    - id: initial-water-rate-bpd
      name: initial_water_rate_bpd
      label: Initial Water Rate Bpd
      description: Initial water production rate in barrels per day.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/initial_water_rate_bpd
    - id: choke-size
      name: choke_size
      label: Choke Size
      description: Initial production test choke size.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/choke_size
    - id: contractors
      name: contractors
      label: Contractors
      description: Completion, cementing, logging, or stimulation contractors.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/contractors
    - id: regulatory-filing-status
      name: regulatory_filing_status
      label: Regulatory Filing Status
      description: Filed, pending, rejected, amended, or other filing status.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/regulatory_filing_status
  validationRules:
    - id: completion-date-present
      severity: error
      description: completion_date is required for Well Completion Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: completion_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: completion_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: completion_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(completion_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: well-name-present
      severity: error
      description: well_name is required for Well Completion Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: well_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: well_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: well_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(well_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: api-well-number-present
      severity: error
      description: api_well_number is required for Well Completion Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: api_well_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: api_well_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: api_well_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(api_well_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: operator-name-present
      severity: error
      description: operator_name is required for Well Completion Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: operator_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: operator_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: operator_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(operator_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: completion-type-present
      severity: error
      description: completion_type is required for Well Completion Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: completion_type
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: completion_type
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: completion_type IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(completion_type)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: total-depth-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: total_depth should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: total_depth
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: total_depth
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: total_depth IS NULL OR total_depth >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: proppant-volume-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: proppant_volume should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: proppant_volume
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: proppant_volume
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: proppant_volume IS NULL OR proppant_volume >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: fluid-volume-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: fluid_volume should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: fluid_volume
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: fluid_volume
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: fluid_volume IS NULL OR fluid_volume >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: initial-oil-rate-bpd-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: initial_oil_rate_bpd should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: initial_oil_rate_bpd
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: initial_oil_rate_bpd
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: initial_oil_rate_bpd IS NULL OR initial_oil_rate_bpd >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: initial-gas-rate-mcfpd-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: initial_gas_rate_mcfpd should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: initial_gas_rate_mcfpd
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: initial_gas_rate_mcfpd
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: initial_gas_rate_mcfpd IS NULL OR initial_gas_rate_mcfpd >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      completion_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Well Completion Report workflow.
      well_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Well Completion Report workflow.
      api_well_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Well Completion Report workflow.
      operator_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Well Completion Report workflow.
      completion_type:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Well Completion Report workflow.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Well Completion Report documents combine upstream operations, production accounting, field
      services, HSE, and lease control context.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      completion_date:
        type: date
        description: Date completion operations finished or report was signed.
        format: date
      well_name:
        type: string
        description: Well name and number.
      api_well_number:
        type: string
        description: API well number or regulatory well identifier.
      operator_name:
        type: string
        description: Operating company.
      field_name:
        type: string
        description: Field, pool, or reservoir name.
      formation:
        type: string
        description: Producing formation or target zone.
      completion_type:
        type: string
        description: Completion type such as hydraulic fracture, open hole, perforated casing, or recompletion.
      total_depth:
        type: number
        description: Total measured depth.
      perforated_intervals:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            perforated_interval_type:
              type: string
              description: Type or class for perforated_intervals item.
            perforated_interval_description:
              type: string
              description: Description for perforated_intervals item.
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Amount or value when stated.
            date:
              type: date
              description: Relevant item date when stated.
              format: date
            status:
              type: string
              description: Item status or disposition when stated.
        description: Perforation intervals with top, bottom, stage, and date when available.
      stimulation_summary:
        type: string
        description: Fracturing, acidizing, stimulation, or treatment summary.
      proppant_volume:
        type: number
        description: Total proppant volume.
      fluid_volume:
        type: number
        description: Total stimulation fluid volume.
      initial_oil_rate_bpd:
        type: number
        description: Initial oil production rate in barrels per day.
      initial_gas_rate_mcfpd:
        type: number
        description: Initial gas production rate in thousand cubic feet per day.
      initial_water_rate_bpd:
        type: number
        description: Initial water production rate in barrels per day.
      choke_size:
        type: string
        description: Initial production test choke size.
      contractors:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Completion, cementing, logging, or stimulation contractors.
      regulatory_filing_status:
        type: string
        description: Filed, pending, rejected, amended, or other filing status.
    required:
      - completion_date
      - well_name
      - api_well_number
      - operator_name
      - completion_type
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: energy_upstream_operations
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - completion_date
          - well_name
          - api_well_number
          - operator_name
          - completion_type
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields:
          - perforated_intervals
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
